clock_map.method: robust fit to neighboring host-clock CSV rows; uncalibrated software approximation

mapping.status: Inferred from same clock grouping, near-static main gravity and much larger secondary gyro motion; physical label pairing should be confirmed at acquisition.

axis_input_source: dominant coordinate of Acc-B-only gravity plane normal; gyro PCA used as independent agreement check, not candidate input
initialization_source: median raw visual projection for 0.4s near first IMU sample; shared initial angle only; no subsequent vision corrections
fixed_base_gate: acc norm deviation<0.6m/s²; projected gravity>0.2g; jerk<30m/s³; gyro norm<.25rad/s; innovation<20deg; tau=1s; invalid gaps>.1s
retained_A_gate: two acc norm/projection/jerk gates; phase rate<.25rad/s and retained A gyro norm<.25rad/s; high dynamics invalid, no pretend-zero B gyro
state: offline only; native gyro integration and acceleration interpolation; axes/clock not independently calibrated
